title: Run the trust CI job on ubuntu-24.04 so the augur risk gate can start
description: Run the trust CI job on ubuntu-24.04 so the augur risk gate can start
no_spec_change_rationale: CI runner pin only; no canonical spec changes. ubuntu-latest is rolling to 26.04, whose libxml2 has SONAME libxml2.so.16, and the prebuilt augur binary the Trust gate runs needs libxml2.so.2 (CorvidLabs/augur#59)
acceptance_criteria: The trust CI job runs on an ubuntu-24.04 runner, so the CorvidLabs Trust gate's augur risk step starts (no libxml2.so.2 exit-127), while every other job's runner is unchanged; the workflow comments name CorvidLabs/augur#59 as the reason and the revert condition
